text:
dana_cs: FYI dropping a compact runbook for Acme onboarding — prefill + streaming fallback + renewal signal checks. short checklist below.

- Checkpoints: prefill, warm pools, batching, stream fallback, and feedback capture.

tyler_pm: awesome, can we add the 24h renewal-signal ping? last time that helped catch a billing mismatch.

dana_cs: good call. add renewal_signal:true to telemetry and set alert if negative NPS or no activity in 48h.

nina_sre: ops notes:
```
prefill: true
warm_pool_size: 5
batch_max_tokens: 256
stream_fallback: true
kv_cache_prefix: tenant_acme_v1
prefill_schedule: immediate
```
- prefer small batches for chat flows, use continuous batching when median latency < 120ms. keep kv cache prefix per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant blowup.

leon_solutions: capture user-facing feedback at 24h and 7d. short one-click survey + one free-text field. tag responses with `onboard_prefill` label.

prefill-bot: prefill job queued for tenant acme-123 (eta ~3m) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

dana_cs: owners: nina -> infra config, leon -> feedback template, tyler -> renewal alarm rule. i'll file the onboarding card and link to the prefill job.

tyler_pm: i'll add the alert in pagerduty with low-priority, and a slack cue to #customer-success if renewal signal fires.

leon_solutions: wording snippet for survey: "How helpful was the initial experience? (1-5)" + optional "What did you expect?" free text. keep it <1 min to finish.

dana_cs: final Qs — any objections to 2h warm-pool TTL? keeps cost low but avoids cold starts.

nina_sre: 2h TTL ok for this scale. :+1: We'll monitor CPU/GPU utilization. Set trace tag `prefill_runway`.

dana_cs: perfect. i'll update the shared runbook and drop the link here when done. :white_check_mark:
